name: playwright-automation-boilerplate
description: Production-ready Playwright automation boilerplate — Config → Helpers → Tests, with optional AI adapters.

scripts.verify: npm run harness:check && npm run harness:test && npm run harness:format:check && npm run check:rules && npx tsc --noEmit && npm test && npm run evidence:build
scripts.harness:format:check: prettier --check harness/profiles/adapters harness/profiles/projects harness/agents harness/qa-automation-foundations.md scripts/harness/test-policy-messages.mjs .claude/hooks/pre-validate-playwright-rules.mjs .claude/hooks/shared-rules.mjs .claude/hooks/validate-playwright-rules.mjs && prettier --check --print-width 100 scripts/harness/check-drift.mjs scripts/harness/sync.mjs scripts/harness/templates.mjs scripts/harness/test-agent-adapters.mjs scripts/harness/test-block-rules-enforced.mjs scripts/harness/test-config-paths-honest.mjs
scripts.harness:test: node scripts/harness/test-policy-messages.mjs && node scripts/harness/test-agent-adapters.mjs && node scripts/harness/test-block-rules-enforced.mjs && node scripts/harness/test-config-paths-honest.mjs && node scripts/harness/test-rule-extensions.mjs && npm run harness:profile:test && npm run harness:profile:verify && npm run evidence:test
scripts.evidence:test: node scripts/test-evidence.mjs && node scripts/test-record-evidence.mjs && node scripts/test-backfill-ci-evidence.mjs
